messages.author: 949f9be37ba0e6cd
messages.subject: Re: Error: is.list(partable) is not TRUE
parts:
Dear Amanda,


I had not noticed this post until now. 

In your email to me you did not mention what error you were getting, so I was not able to guess the problem. But in this thread I see that it is "is.list(partable) is not TRUE". This allows me to understand the problem. 

lavaan.survey expects as its 1st argument a fitted lavaan object (as resulting, for example from cfa(), lavaan() etc). Instead you have given it a string (text) with the lavaan syntax. So change this to 

fit <- lavaan(model, further arguments as necessary)

fit.surv <- lavaan.survey(fit, mydesign)

and this problem should be solved. 

Note also that you can find many examples of how to use lavaan.survey in the soon-to-appear JSS paper, preprint here: http://daob.nl/publications/  

Best,
Daniel
